en: Hmm... If we put the engine here, the hull bends there... I can't make heads or tails of these plans.
Oh, sorry! I'm Dock, Captain Stern's foreman. Parts from Devon? For the captain?
He's not here. He went over to the Oceanic Museum. Could you take them to him there?
The captain's at the Oceanic Museum, just up the road. Please get those parts to him!
Thanks to those parts, the submarine's coming along. But I could use the advice of an old sea hand.
